data.one_liner: Language picker dropdowns, dialogs, and Cupertino pickers for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use widgets like dropdowns, dialogs, and Cupertino sheets to let users select a language from a list of predefined languages or ISO codes. Includes controllers for programmatic updates and custom item builders.
use_when: You need a dropdown or dialog specifically for selecting languages in your app.
You want support for standard language names and ISO codes out of the box.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose picker or drop-down for non-language data.
You need advanced localization translation engines rather than just a picker widget.
strengths: Includes multiple UI variants: dropdown, dialog, and Cupertino picker.
Provides a controller to programmatically change the selected language.
weaknesses: Limited to language picking functionality only.
Relies entirely on preset static lists of languages.
